text: Mobile app development has become an important skill for many programmers today. When building an app, developers must think about responsive design, so the layout works well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one system, while cross-platform tools let you create one app for several platforms. After development, apps are usually published on app stores, where users can download them. Performance is another key factor, because slow or buggy apps frustrate users and often get deleted quickly. Good planning helps developers create successful apps.
